in_marathi.name: Anudeep
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anudeep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anu means 'tiny drop' and Deep means 'ocean of knowledge'. This name signifies being a source of endless wisdom and knowledge, like a drop in the ocean. It's a powerful name that resonates with enlightenment and knowledge.
